title: Coefficient of a sum and a monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $S,T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be finite sets with $T$ nonempty and $S\cap T=\varnothing$. The algebraic normal form coefficient indexed by $T$ of the function that adds the sum of coordinates in $S$ to the monomial given by the product of coordinates in $T$, over the field with two elements, is $1$.
